image.alt: Bathroom remodeling Redmond WA by Remont: navy subway tile walk-in shower with brass-framed glass door, pebble floor, wood slat wall and heated towel rail

intro.h2: A small Eastside crew with a bath-first focus
paragraphs: Remont Remodeling handles bathroom remodeling in Redmond, WA and the nearby Eastside from a suite in the Overlake Office Center on NE Bel Red Road. Owner Viktor Chirkin keeps the company small on purpose. It takes a selected number of projects at a time, so every job gets his direct oversight from consultation to final walkthrough.

Most calls are about showers. The team converts tubs to walk-in showers, builds barrier-free entries with grab bars and built-in seats, and sets custom tile over full waterproofing. Kitchens and whole-house projects are on the list too. Clients hear from the crew every day by text, email or phone, with progress photos.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Redmond, WA, from tubs to tile

items.name: Tub-to-Shower Conversions
items.blurb: The old tub comes out and a custom shower goes in, with options like a barrier-free entry, grab bars and a built-in seat. The design phase takes about 2 to 3 business days, and every conversion carries a 5-year parts and labor warranty.

image.alt: Walk-in shower conversion with white handmade-look tile, rainfall head, grab bar and a frameless glass panel

items.name: Walk-In Shower Installation
items.blurb: Barrier-free entries, custom tile and frameless glass, with ADA-compliant options if you plan to age in place. Installation usually takes 2 to 3 weeks after a 5 to 10 day design phase, with a dedicated project manager and a written warranty of up to 5 years.

image.alt: Gray tile walk-in shower with a built-in bench, twin wall niches and a frameless glass enclosure

items.name: Full Bathroom Renovation
items.blurb: Complete tear-outs, layout changes, new plumbing and electrical, and high-end finishes. Renovations take about 2 to 4 weeks of work and include a three-year written warranty on labor and materials. Remont reports more than 300 bathroom renovations completed across the Eastside.

image.alt: Bathroom renovation with a long dark wood double vanity, gray quartz top and backlit oval mirrors

items.name: Bathroom Additions
items.blurb: For a growing family, a new bathroom starts with a space assessment, permits, and plumbing and electrical tie-ins. Most additions take 3 to 6 weeks, depending on structural work. Remont reports more than 200 additions in Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond and Seattle.

image.alt: Long bathroom with white double vanity, lighted mirror and a sliding glass shower at the far end

items.name: Custom Tile Work
items.blurb: Porcelain, mosaic or natural stone set over professional waterproofing, in bathrooms and kitchens. Reviewers single out the tile: one called it perfection, and another wrote that every tile was perfectly aligned and every grout line flawless.

image.alt: Tub surround in large blue and gold marble-look porcelain tile with matte black shower fixtures

items.title: Written estimates within two days
items.text: After a 60 to 90 minute in-home consultation, a written estimate with materials, labor and timeline arrives within 24 to 48 hours. Up to two revisions are included at no extra charge.

items.title: Licensed, bonded and insured
items.text: Washington GC License REMONRL761D5, bonded through CBIC (67000453) and insured through CBIC (G11FE2683), with workers' compensation coverage on every project.

items.title: Daily updates with photos
items.text: You hear from the team every day by text, email or phone, and milestones are documented in photos. Reviewers who were away during the work say the updates kept them informed.

items.title: Set hours, clean site
items.text: Crews work 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, protect floors with coverings and dust barriers, and clean the job site before leaving each day.

about.text: Viktor Chirkin owns Remont Remodeling and is a Washington State licensed general contractor (License REMONRL761D5). He brings more than a decade of bathroom and kitchen experience and has overseen hundreds of projects across the Eastside. He knows local codes, permits and inspections, and he keeps direct contact with clients through every job. As a local homeowner himself, he takes on only the projects he can supervise closely. The company rule is quality over quantity, and reviews back it up with praise for tile alignment, cleanup and staying on schedule.

steps.title: Free consultation
steps.text: A 60 to 90 minute visit to measure and photograph your space, check conditions and talk through goals, timeline and budget, with no sales pressure.

steps.title: Written estimate
steps.text: Within 24 to 48 hours you get a breakdown of materials, labor, timeline and permit costs. Two revisions are included at no charge.

steps.title: Contract and design
steps.text: The contract is ready in one to two business days. Final materials and fixtures are confirmed, permits are submitted and a start date is set.

steps.title: Construction
steps.text: Work runs 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM behind dust barriers, with daily progress photos and multi-point quality checks along the way.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: You review every detail against a quality checklist and receive warranty papers and care guides. The project closes only when you are satisfied.

service_area.text: Remont is based in Redmond's Overlake area and works in Redmond, Bellevue, Kirkland and Seattle. Its Kirkland page mentions homes in Market, Juanita and Totem Lake, and notes quick response times because the office is minutes away. Permits in each city are handled for you, from application to final inspection. Call the office to check whether your street is in range.

faq.h2: Questions about your Redmond bathroom project

items.a: Yes. The first consultation is free and lasts 60 to 90 minutes in your home. Within 24 to 48 hours you receive a written estimate with materials, labor, timeline and any permit costs, and up to two revisions are included at no additional charge. There is no obligation to sign.

items.q: What warranty comes with a new shower?
items.a: Coverage is in writing and depends on the service. Tub-to-shower conversions carry a 5-year parts and labor warranty, walk-in showers carry up to 5 years, full bathroom renovations include three years on labor and materials, and bathroom additions get 2 years on labor plus the manufacturer warranties on materials.

items.q: Do I need a permit for a bathroom remodel in Redmond?
items.a: Many projects that move plumbing, change electrical or add a room need one. Remont identifies the required permits during the estimate, explains the costs, then submits and tracks the applications for you and schedules the inspections. Viktor knows the code and inspection process in each city the company serves.

items.q: Can you remodel my kitchen too?
items.a: Yes. Bathrooms and kitchens are the company's two specialties. Kitchen work covers cabinetry, countertops, plumbing, electrical and appliance coordination. The design phase usually takes 7 to 14 days, and installation runs 4 to 8 weeks depending on size. Remont reports more than 250 completed kitchen renovations.

items.q: How do you protect my home during the work?
items.a: Floors get coverings, work areas get dust barriers, and materials are stored securely and staged in an organized way. Crews keep an 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM schedule and clean the job site before they leave each day, so the rest of the house stays livable while your bathroom is rebuilt.
